# Dispatch

> Dispatch is a self-hosted, AWS-native email API and control plane built on Amazon SES.

This index lists the tracked public guides selected by `scripts/llms.ts`.
Links are relative to this file in `docs/`.

## Documentation

- [Dispatch](../README.md): Product overview, local quickstart, sending from code, and production setup.
- [Agent tooling](agent-tools.md): Public LLM docs, local SDK-backed stdio MCP tools, permissions and read-only mode.
- [API](api/README.md): Authentication, permissions, response shapes, sending, and REST routes.
- [Audience](audience.md): Contacts, typed properties, CSV imports, topics, and static segments.
- [Automations](automations.md): Triggers, re-entry, email kinds, conditions, waits, and run controls.
- [Lifecycle recipes](automations/README.md): Goal, app-owned fields, exact graph, freshness and install/review/enable examples.
- [Come back](automations/come-back.md): Goal, app-owned fields, exact graph, freshness and install/review/enable examples.
- [Failed payment](automations/failed-payment.md): Goal, app-owned fields, exact graph, freshness and install/review/enable examples.
- [Invite to upgrade](automations/invite-to-upgrade.md): Goal, app-owned fields, exact graph, freshness and install/review/enable examples.
- [Newsletter welcome](automations/newsletter-welcome.md): Goal, app-owned fields, exact graph, freshness and install/review/enable examples.
- [Onboarding drip](automations/onboarding-drip.md): Goal, app-owned fields, exact graph, freshness and install/review/enable examples.
- [Win back](automations/win-back.md): Goal, app-owned fields, exact graph, freshness and install/review/enable examples.
- [AWS](aws.md): AWS resources and permissions for SES, S3, and delivery queues.
- [CLI](cli.md): CLI credentials, commands, flags, output, and errors.
- [Deliverability](deliverability/README.md): Sender authentication, reputation, suppression, and delivery tracking.
- [Domains](domains.md): Sending domain setup, DNS records, verification, and diagnostics.
- [Goals](goals.md): Retroactive real-send conversion cohorts, eligibility and retained-history limits.
- [Integrations](integrations.md): Signed receivers, setup, provider mappings and body-free delivery history.
- [Local development](local.md): Local services, development fixtures, and the fake sending provider.
- [Migration](migration/README.md): Moving an existing Resend integration to a self-hosted Dispatch instance.
- [Operations](operations/README.md): Environment settings, background workers, storage, and service operations.
- [React Email](react-email.md): Authoring, rendering, and publishing React Email templates.
- [Self-hosting](self-hosting/README.md): Local and production deployment, required resources, and SES configuration.
- [Settings](settings.md): Tenant defaults for imports and sandbox email domains.
- [SMTP relay](smtp.md): SMTP authentication, transport configuration, and supported sending behavior.
- [Templates](templates.md): Template publishing, variables, branding, and Transactional or Marketing kinds.
- [Template recipes](templates/README.md): Email template integration recipes organized by provider.
- [Auth.js](templates/authjs.md): Sending Auth.js authentication email through Dispatch.
- [Better Auth](templates/better-auth.md): Sending Better Auth email with Dispatch templates.
- [Clerk](templates/clerk.md): Using the SMTP relay for Clerk-rendered authentication email.
- [Stripe](templates/stripe.md): Sending invoice and trial email from Stripe webhooks.
- [Supabase](templates/supabase.md): Mapping Supabase Auth send-email hooks to Dispatch templates.
- [Brand theme tokens](templates/theme.md): Safe theme tokens and explicit library updates that skip edited copies.
- [Standard Webhooks](templates/webhook.md): Signed receiver setup, mapping, replay handling and delivery history.
- [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md): Diagnosing common setup, delivery, storage, and webhook failures.
- [Webhooks](webhooks.md): Email and automation events, signature verification, retries, and replay.
